title: VIXEN configure does not provision the required Undertow textshader provider
body: The first queued cmake -S VIXEN --preset vixen-wsl failed at VIXEN/libraries/Text/CMakeLists.txt because the auto-derived /home/liory/projects/undertow checkout lacked transpiled/textshader/Text/{Text.g.h,Text.g.glsl}. I had to select the paired generated provider worktree and rerun the same queued configure with UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow/.claude-worktrees/pair-kernel-858f41b873. Suggested consolidation: make the VIXEN preset resolve or validate the paired Undertow provider and its generated textshader interface before configure.

title: VIXEN GPU capture fixtures do not prepare their producer runtimes
body: The exact queued dzn CTest repro initially failed before the named cases because build/wsl/binaries/VIXEN was absent; after building VIXEN, the editor producer exposed a second missing dependency, build/wsl/binaries/vixen_editor. I had to run queued cmake --build build/wsl --target VIXEN vixen_editor test_rendergraph_criticalnodes_windowedcapture test_headless_ui_graph --parallel 4 before the repro could execute. Suggested consolidation: declare or provide one focused fixture-preparation target that builds every runtime consumed by the editor/HUD/headless capture tests.

title: VIXEN cold capture witness must rebase standalone expected-file paths
body: The queued dzn Application.LookdevCapture.GlyphSdf.latin-carved.ColdBound test passed its nested CTest but failed because measure-cold-pipeline.py checked the baked build-tree --expect-file while the capture wrapper wrote under the queue's runtime capture root. I had to route the cold-bound registration through vixen_capture_command and extend run_with_capture_root.cmake to rebase command arguments as well as environment variables. Suggested consolidation: make every capture witness use one declared runtime-root wrapper for both output and expected-file arguments.
